summary: The AddDevice class extends HPXRebrandingFlow and provides comprehensive page object methods for the Add Device functionality in HP Smart. It includes verification methods for UI elements, action methods for user interactions (clicks and text input), and getter methods for retrieving element values. The class follows a consistent pattern of using driver.wait_for_object for verifications, driver.click for actions, and driver.send_keys for input operations. Most methods use timeout parameters for reliability, with verification methods supporting optional raise_e parameters for exception handling.
